meta.source: DfE Get Information About Schools (GIAS), all establishments download
meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (DfE).
meta.method: Daily CSV (windows-1252) of every establishment, open and closed; kept: E14 postcode, or Easting/Northing in the box. lat/lon converted from GIAS Easting/Northing (BNG) with OSTN15 (tools/lib.mjs bngProjector).
fields_dropped: head teacher title, first name, last name and preferred job title
SEN, gender, religious character, admissions and other policy fields
Ofsted rating fields (Ofsted is the source for those)
census and FSM counts except NumberOfPupils
meta.note: GIAS Easting/Northing kept as e, n. "Fieldwork Overseas Establishments" (schools abroad; counts.correspondence_addresses) and other c/o rows give a correspondence address at 30 Skylines Village, E14 9TS: address_role marks them; they are not schools in E14 (same class as registered offices, SE-1).
meta.membership: in_box: the source coordinate lies in the box, or (no source coordinate) the ONSPD centre of the postcode does; in_e14: postcode district E14. Kept: either.
